baseline_models.focus_anchor: The subject الصبح at word 1 is joined by إذا to the active verb تنفس at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The morning opening is construed as a body-like aperture: breath crosses from an interior to an exterior, while the dedicated dawn branch extends breathing to daybreak opening and spreading. The event is progressive expansion rather than a punctual light switch.

activation_trace.role: Dawn as the opening of the day supplies the temporal body whose boundary is beginning to open.
Air leaving an interior supplies the outward vector and makes the opening an exhalation.
Opening and spreading at dawn directly anchors the bodily image in the focus event rather than leaving it a free metaphor.

changed_reading.before: Dawn simply arrives and is ornamentally personified as breathing.
changed_reading.after: The oath catches dawn during an inside-to-outside opening: morning progressively exhales itself into available space.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The form تنفس at word 3 can name the making of room, not only respiration.
baseline_models.mechanism: Breathing functions as decompression. Dawn is the phase in which a constricted interval gains room, distance, and delay, so its emergence is experienced as release from pressure.

activation_trace.role: The opening of morning supplies the temporal transition in which constriction can end.
Relief by giving breath and space turns respiration into the operative removal of distress.
Leeway, distance, and extension make the result of the breath spatial and temporal room.

changed_reading.before: Morning follows night as the next time period.
changed_reading.after: Morning is sworn by at the precise action of making room after constriction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The active singular تنفس predicates a life-indexing act of الصبح itself.
baseline_models.mechanism: Breath is evidence of life and selfhood. The syntax temporarily grants dawn an inward center and a living identity, so morning does not merely contain animate beings; it wakes as an animate whole.

activation_trace.role: The named morning opening provides the entity that receives temporary agency.
Breath as the sign of the living soul makes the dawn's activity a pulse of life.
The very self or identity of a thing supplies dawn with an interior whole capable of acting.

changed_reading.before: The verse transfers one human action to an otherwise inert time of day.
changed_reading.after: The breath is a momentary sign that dawn itself has become a living, self-bearing actor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening sense of تنفس at word 3 can be carried by a branch that also names birth and emergence from a body.
baseline_models.mechanism: Dawn's opening can be modeled as delivery: a new interval exits enclosure with breath, fluid, and bodily cost. This is not identical to ordinary relief, because it makes morning a newly emerged life rather than merely cleared space.

activation_trace.role: Birth and postpartum emergence supply the passage of new life from an enclosing interior.
Dawn opening and spreading keeps the birth analogy attached to the actual verbal construction.
The first opening of the day supplies what is being delivered into temporal presence.

changed_reading.before: Dawn takes a breath after appearing.
changed_reading.after: Dawn appears by a birth-like breathing open, as though the new day itself has just crossed out of enclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins a morning branch carrying raid and alarm to an outward breath at تنفس.
baseline_models.mechanism: An exhalation can carry an alarm. The morning opening is therefore not necessarily tranquil: its first outward movement may function as an abrupt warning that reaches those still enclosed in night.

activation_trace.role: The dawn raid and its alarm cry supply a threatening or warning-bearing morning register.
Breath moving outward supplies the carrier by which the morning alarm leaves its source.

changed_reading.before: Breathing makes the dawn gentle and restorative.
changed_reading.after: The same breath can be dawn's warning blast, making the opening sudden and exposing rather than merely soothing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rolling together, plunging dispersal, and removal of a covering establish alternating compression and exposure. Against those motions, dawn's active opening reads as a pressure valve inside cosmic dismantling, not as an untouched pastoral sunrise.

activation_trace.role: Relief through added room supplies the release pole of the revised mechanism.
Dawn's opening and spreading gives the release a visible expansion anchored in the verb.
Rolling and gathering parts together supplies an initial compression against which dawn can vent.
Scattered plunging motion prevents the release from being read as calm restoration and keeps it within collapse.
Removal of a cover supplies the exposure phase that parallels an aperture opening.

structural_cues: The repeated passive إذا clauses in 81:1-13 make the active singular breathing of 81:18 conspicuous.
The focus arrives after multiple closed, stable, or elevated structures have been folded, displaced, or uncovered.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: compression, plunging dispersal, uncovering, and an active dawn opening. Reader arrow: accumulated pressure is released through the dawn-like aperture. Live alternative: the images are parallel signs with no causal pressure relation.

changed_reading.before: Dawn's breath is a self-contained image of natural ease.
changed_reading.after: Dawn is the venting phase of a cosmos being compacted and stripped open, so relief and catastrophe coexist in one breath.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch itself permits water and waves to swell or throw outward like breath. The context's wide waters and the live fullness/emptying polarity of سجر therefore shift the image from lungs to a tidal body whose opening can be both influx and discharge.

activation_trace.role: The branch explicitly includes water or waves swelling and casting outward, anchoring the tidal analogy in تنفس.
Life-sustaining water makes the spreading medium vital rather than merely scenic.
Abundant wide water supplies the large material body that can expand and discharge.
Filling with water supplies the inhalation-like pole of the tidal pulse.
Water receding or emptying supplies the opposed exhalation-like pole without resolving the lexical polarity.

structural_cues: 81:6 places a plural body of water under a passive transformation before the singular dawn later acts for itself.
The focus branch inventory itself groups dawn-opening with wave expansion, allowing a material bridge rather than topic association alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: wide waters, both filling and emptying branches, and a focus branch joining dawn to wave expansion. Reader arrow: the paired water motions form an inhale/exhale cycle. Live alternative: سجر selects ignition here, leaving the hydrological pulse only exploratory.

changed_reading.before: The dawn is anthropomorphized with lungs.
changed_reading.after: The dawn can breathe as a tidal field, alternately swelling and casting outward across the horizon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that animates dawn later names selves that are joined to counterparts and a self that recognizes what it has made present. Dawn's singular breath can therefore act as a macro-self image: an inward whole becomes alive, related, and answerable through what exits it.

activation_trace.role: The living self supplies the focus model's animate center.
An inward mind or intent supplies content that breathing can externalize.
The contextual plural of living selves scales the focus's animate predicate from one body to a field of lives.
Joining each counterpart supplies relation and reconstitution rather than isolated animation.
Something becoming disclosed to a knower supplies the self-recognition phase.
Presence, proximity, and witnessing make what was inward stand before the self.

structural_cues: نفس occurs before the focus in both plural and singular forms, surrounding cosmic transformations with personal identity.
The active focus predicate stands between the self-accounting scene of 81:14 and the later discourse about transmitted speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: living selves are paired, a self knows what it has brought present, and dawn performs a life-sign. Reader arrow: the cosmos is temporarily modeled as a self whose outward breath manifests an interior. Live alternative: the repeated root links human selves only lexically, without scaling personhood to dawn.

changed_reading.before: Dawn merely borrows an organism's breathing motion.
changed_reading.after: Dawn behaves as a macro-self coming alive and exposing what its interior carries, alongside rather than instead of the human-self reading.

context_deltas.mechanism: An outward breath can become the minimal material condition of voice. The questioned silenced victim and the opened written record activate dawn's relief as recovered capacity to testify: what was enclosed or suppressed is given air, spread, and inspectable form.

activation_trace.role: Breath leaving the body supplies the physical precondition for an outward voice.
Making room for the afflicted turns the dawn opening into restored expressive capacity.
Question and request supply the judicial demand to which recovered expression can answer.
Opening, flattening, and branching outward give the released content an inspectable spread.
The opened written record supplies durable testimony rather than a vanishing exhalation.

structural_cues: The branchless و ء د occurrence at 81:8 is used only as the structural cue of a victim placed before questioning; no branch identity is inferred for it.
Questioning in 81:8-9 is followed by records being opened in 81:10, forming a speech-to-document sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a silenced victim is questioned, records are opened, and the focus supplies outward breath plus relief. Reader arrow: restored breath enables suppressed testimony to enter the record. Live alternative: the judicial sequence and dawn oath remain separate evidentiary scenes.

changed_reading.before: Dawn's breath releases darkness or atmospheric pressure.
changed_reading.after: Dawn also figures the world regaining breath enough for buried testimony to become question, answer, and opened record.

context_deltas.mechanism: The relief branch remains live, but the adjacent activation of consuming heat and driven nearness blocks an automatically comforting reading. Opening creates exposure and approach; context leaves the object of that approach bifurcated rather than guaranteeing safety.

activation_trace.role: Relief by added room supplies the baseline positive valence now being qualified.
Intense blazing heat supplies a possible content disclosed by the opening rather than relief from all danger.
Deliberate kindling makes exposure active and escalating, weakening a purely soothing dawn.
Movement driven toward nearness supplies the opposed possibility that opening brings a desired destination close.

structural_cues: 81:12 and 81:13 place intensified fire and an approaching garden in parallel passive clauses.
The oath at 81:18 follows both outcomes and therefore cannot inherit only one affective valence without an extra choice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: relief, kindled heat, and driven nearness coexist. Reader arrow: breathing opens access to what has been prepared, whether threatening or desired. Live alternative: dawn relief is wholly independent of the outcome pair and retains an unqualified positive tone.

changed_reading.before: Giving dawn breath means uncomplicated comfort after distress.
changed_reading.after: The breath still creates room, but that room is exposure to divergent outcomes; relief is structural, not sentimental safety.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retreating, flowing, entering shelter, and darkness thinning at both edges create a recurrent visibility cycle. Dawn's breath is therefore one phase of a larger respiration in which appearances withdraw and return; it is not a one-way victory that abolishes night.

activation_trace.role: Outward breath supplies one directional phase of the cycle.
Opening and spreading at dawn identifies the visible expansion phase.
Withdrawal into concealment supplies the inverse, inward phase.
Continuous flowing keeps the phases dynamically connected rather than making them separate tableaux.
Celestial bodies disappearing into hiding supplies a repeatable contraction of visibility.
Night's darkness supplies the medium that alternately thickens and thins.
Thin darkness at both ends of night prevents a single-direction reading and supplies two respiratory boundaries.

structural_cues: The oath sequence 81:15-18 moves directly from concealed moving bodies to night at its edge and dawn opening.
The paired إذا constructions of 81:17 and 81:18 give night and dawn matching phase-sensitive predicates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: celestial retreat and flow, concealment, two night edges, and dawn expansion. Reader arrow: withdrawal and emergence are treated as alternating respiratory phases. Live alternative: the sequence describes several independent observable cycles without making the cosmos one breathing system.

changed_reading.before: Dawn exhales once, ending night in a linear transition.
changed_reading.after: Dawn's opening is the outward stroke of a recurrent boundary-breath in which visibility also withdraws and night can return.

context_deltas.mechanism: Breath carries inward content across a bodily boundary; speech gives that current articulated form, sending gives it direction, and trust marks faithful arrival. The dawn image can thus model transmission itself: an unseen interior becomes an outward, receivable saying without losing its source relation.

activation_trace.role: Air crossing from inside to outside supplies the material carrier for transmission.
Hidden thought or intent supplies the interior content that can be borne outward.
Voiced saying turns the outgoing current into articulated content.
Dispatch and outward movement give the articulated content a directed path.
Messenger and message make the carrier-content distinction explicit within that path.
Security and settled trust qualify the transmission as faithful rather than contaminating.

structural_cues: 81:19 begins immediately after the dawn oath with إنه لقول, allowing the oath image to bear on the mode of the saying.
The following predicates move from saying to messenger, power, obedience, and trustworthiness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: outward breath, inward content, spoken saying, dispatch, messenger, and trust. Reader arrow: the dawn's breathing is an enacted analogy for faithful inside-to-outside transmission. Live alternative: dawn serves only as an oath witness and does not model how the saying travels.

changed_reading.before: The dawn oath merely authenticates the proposition that follows.
changed_reading.after: The dawn's own exhalation can stage how a hidden content becomes an outward, trusted saying through a commissioned carrier.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preciousness branch of نفس includes rivalry and withholding over valued content. A manifest horizon followed by denial of withholding the unseen reverses that potential: dawn breath becomes a valuable interior freely released until hidden distinctions become visible.

activation_trace.role: Precious value desired and withheld by selves supplies the live possibility of hoarding.
Breath leaving its interior reverses retention by enacting release.
Appearance and uncovering supply the visible result of the release.
Clarifying meaning by speech or sign connects visible dawn to communicative disclosure.
What is screened from eyes supplies the interior or concealed content awaiting disclosure.
Holding back or stinginess supplies the denied action whose reverse is open exhalation.

structural_cues: 81:23-24 move from a manifest horizon to unseen content that is not withheld.
The focus breath physically precedes this visible/hidden contrast and provides a boundary-crossing action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a preciousness/withholding branch, outward breath, manifestness, hidden content, and denied withholding. Reader arrow: dawn models valuable disclosure as release rather than hoarding. Live alternative: the preciousness branch is inactive here and the passage concerns only a messenger's reliability.

changed_reading.before: Dawn releases ordinary air or light from behind night.
changed_reading.after: Dawn figures a precious hidden content being given without hoarding, its exhalation turning concealment into communicable distinction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Breath-generated room becomes an affordance for agency: attraction or willing selects an object, rising undertakes it, and straightness stabilizes the course. Final governing nurture limits the reading from self-sufficient autonomy, so dawn opens a real but conditioned interval for alignment.

activation_trace.role: Relief from constriction supplies the enabling release before action.
Leeway and room supply the practical interval in which a course can be chosen.
Will directed toward a thing supplies selection within the opened interval.
Resolve and rising toward an undertaking supplies the transition from possibility to motion.
Straightness and balance supply the direction and stable form of the resulting course.
Nurture, repair, and completion place the opened human course within a larger enabling governance.

structural_cues: The closing sequence moves from reminder, to whoever wills to straighten, to the conditioning of that will.
The earlier dawn breath supplies an enacted opening before the later explicit language of choosing and alignment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: relief and leeway, directed will, rising, straightness, and governing completion. Reader arrow: the dawn opening creates the actionable room in which straightening can occur. Live alternative: the oath is only proof of the reminder and contributes no model of enabled agency.

changed_reading.before: Dawn's breathing is a cosmic event observed from outside.
changed_reading.after: Dawn's breath also enacts the opening of conditioned room in which a self can rise, choose, and become straight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses respiration into drinking, but both roots in the focus independently supply a morning drink, a breath-sized draught, and life-sustaining water. It remains focus-anchored at both الصبح and تنفس; downstream prose should present a measured-draught material analogy, not claim that dawn literally drinks.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two focus roots meet in branches for the morning drink and a breath or pause taken while drinking.

activation_trace.role: Morning drink or watering supplies the temporal and material setting of a draught.
A drinking breath or draught supplies measured intake and pause as the operative rhythm.
Life-sustaining water makes each measured opening restorative and vital.

changed_reading.before: Dawn takes or releases one atmospheric breath.
changed_reading.after: Dawn may arrive in breath-sized draughts, a measured taking and giving of the medium by which life stands.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation depends on the packet's non-dominant س ل ل mapping for the contextual root س ء ل, so it is form-distant and must not replace the ordinary questioning branch. It remains worth carrying because gentle drawing-out supplies exactly the boundary crossing already anchored by dawn's outward breath; downstream prose should label it a split-root echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening dawn and outward تنفس at words 1 and 3 can be construed as something gradually drawn from enclosure.

activation_trace.role: The morning opening supplies what emerges from the enclosing night.
Breath leaving an interior anchors the emergence as a real outward crossing.
Gentle, hidden drawing-out supplies a slow extraction mechanism for dawn's emergence.

changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root echo, dawn can be heard as gently drawn out of night the way breath is drawn from an interior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The narrow-aperture cue comes from the non-dominant س م م mapping of contextual س م و and is therefore deliberately branch-distant; pairing it with explicit skin removal is vivid but not a lexical gloss of the focus. It remains anchored because تنفس itself carries opening and spreading, while downstream prose should qualify the cosmic-membrane rendering as an abductive material image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening/spreading branch of تنفس at word 3 permits dawn to act through an aperture rather than only like a pair of lungs.

activation_trace.role: Opening and spreading supplies the focus-side aperture action.
A narrow opening through which something enters supplies a split-root pore in the upper covering.
Skin removal supplies the membrane-like material whose exposure makes the pore vivid.

changed_reading.before: Dawn is a whole organism that breathes.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, dawn is the breath passing through a newly exposed pore in a peeled cosmic covering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The swelling-breath cue belongs to the non-dominant ر ب و mapping under contextual ر ب ب, so it cannot define رب or serve as a direct theological gloss. It remains a live echo because the focus verb already denotes breath opening and expansion, and the dominant contextual branch contributes nurture and completion; downstream prose should mark the swelling-growth link as split-root resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The spreading تنفس at word 3 can be heard as expansion or rising rather than exhalation alone.

activation_trace.role: Opening and spreading supplies the focus-side expansion that the contextual echo intensifies.
Nurture, repair, and completion supply a dominant growth-oriented frame without equating it with breath.
Breath rising and swelling supplies the non-dominant split-root echo of upward expansion.

changed_reading.before: Dawn breathes outward across a horizontal boundary.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, its breath can also rise and swell as a nurtured world-opening still under governing completion.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from decorative personification to a literalized aperture process: an interior progressively becomes exterior.
The adjacent retreating bodies and two-edged night changed a one-way sunrise into one phase of a recurrent visibility-breath cycle.
The immediate saying-and-messenger sequence activated dawn's exhalation as a model of faithful transmission from hidden content to receivable speech.
Questioning and opened records activated breath as restored testimony, while fire and nearness prevented relief from becoming uncomplicated comfort.
The closing will-and-straightness sequence changed cosmic breathing into conditioned room for agency without eliminating the material and judicial readings.
summary.what_was_special: The focus roots already contained unusually concrete cross-domain bridges: dawn opening, bodily exhalation, decompression, birth, water-wave expansion, precious withholding, and the morning draught. Context did not select one gloss; it organized those branches into several coexisting mechanisms, with split-root echoes retained only under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the breathing action is best directed outward as exhalation or held as a full inhale/exhale cycle remains unresolved.
The pressure-valve and tidal models share expansion but may describe independent material analogies rather than one cosmic physiology.
The testimony and transmission models both turn breath into communication, yet one is judicial recovery and the other commissioned fidelity; they should not be merged without loss.
The س ل ل, س م م, and ر ب و activations depend on non-dominant split mappings and must remain exploratory echoes rather than lexical claims.
